title: Paloma and the Archive
author: W. M. Voss
blurb: Beatrix Winterbourne, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
